title: staged shadow + A/B rollout: manual quarantine, observability, and autorollback workflow
author: Ethan Chen
description:
Summary: Add staged A/B + shadow rollout workflow with manual quarantine step and improved observability to support safe progressive rollouts and automatic rollback decisions. Motivation: customers running mixed workloads (hosted + dedicated) need finer-grained rollout controls: staged A/B for multi-variant experiments, shadow probing for regression detection, a manual quarantine to pause/inspect traffic before aborting, and richer metrics to make autorollback decisions explainable. This PR implements the workflow orchestration, metric plumbing, UI status, and e2e tests.

What this changes: staged rollout state machine (staged -> probe-shadow -> canary-ab -> manual-quarantine -> promote/rollback), new metric adapters for composite SLOs, quorum-based metric voting for autorollback, explicit audit events and traces for every decision, and a console status page component to surface quarantine actions.

Checklist implemented: - [x] State machine + workflow engine integration - [x] Shadow probing hooks + configurable probe payloads - [x] A/B traffic split + staged weight ramping - [x] Manual quarantine API + console action - [x] Composite metric adapters and quorum thresholds - [x] Additional rollout metrics (rollback-reason, decision-evidence, quorum-count) - [x] E2E and integration tests (unit, integration, e2e-canary) - [x] Docs: rollout patterns and operator guide

Backward compatibility: Workflow defaults to previous behavior when no staged policy is provided (no breaking changes). Configuration keys added but optional.

Rollout plan: merged -> deploy to staging -> gated rollout to canary hosts with staged flags enabled -> monitor new metrics (rollback_reasons and quorum_count) -> promote when thresholds satisfied. If quorum votes exceed failure threshold the autorollback engine triggers immediate rollback and emits audit events for investigation.
commits: feat(rollouts): add staged AB+shadow workflow state machine and orchestrator
feat(metrics): composite-metric adapter + quorum voting logic for autorollback
feat(api): manual quarantine endpoint + audit event emission
test(e2e): staged rollout e2e tests covering shadow probes and manual quarantine
chore(docs): rollout operator guide and examples
fix(tests): flake fixes for e2e timing under CI
review_comments: Priya Shah: overall looks good; please add more logging around the quorum decision path so oncall can debug production failures faster.
Ethan Chen (author): added structured logs for decision inputs and included trace ids in audit events (see pkg/audit/events.go).
Diego Morales: nit on naming - suggest `quorum_threshold` -> `failure_quorum_threshold` for clarity; also ensure unit tests cover edge-case where probes return intermittent timeouts.
Ethan Chen (author): renamed the config key and added timeout edge-case tests in tests/integration/test_quorum_logic.py.
Leah Kim: ran perf benchmark; memory overhead for KV cache during staged probe is +2.7% — acceptable but add a note in release notes. Approved after fixes.
merge_outcome: Merged to main via squash. Deployments will enable the staged-workflow feature flag in staging for 24h of Canary telemetry before enabling in production. Autorollback will be enabled behind a feature flag and default to manual-quarantine mode for the first rollout.
release_notes: Add staged A/B + shadow rollout workflow with manual quarantine and improved observability. Operators can configure quorum-based autorollback thresholds and view decision evidence in the Console. Note: small memory overhead (+~2.7%) during shadow probes; recommend monitoring rollout_reasons metric after initial deployment.
notes: Follow-up work planned: (1) expose per-model probe payload templates, (2) add traffic shaping integration for dedicated pools, (3) extend e2e stability tests to multi-region scenarios. Tracked in ENG-1801.
